selected_evidence.summary: Shows RHEL 10.0, the unchanged 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 kernel, existing LVM tooling, and the same release/kernel after restart.
Shows the dedicated XFS mount, enabled persistence service, retained LVM recovery_point, and a successful read-only snapshot content verification.

selected_evidence.requirement: After modification, restore the exact content captured by an earlier snapshot
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the captured snapshot and manifest, divergent modifications, successful snapshot merge, and byte-identical restored manifest, hashes, files, permissions, and symlink.
Shows the healthy pre-restart baseline and boot ID, acknowledged reboot request, changed boot ID, and recovered service, mount, data, snapshot, and system health.

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/sbin/appdata-volume <<'APPDATA_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/appdata-storage/lvm.img
mountpoint_path=/srv/data
vg=appdata_vg
lv=/dev/appdata_vg/appdata

find_loop() {
    losetup -j "$backing" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p'
}

case "${1:-}" in
    start)
        loopdev=$(find_loop)
        if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
            loopdev=$(losetup --find --show "$backing")
        fi
        lvmdevices --adddev "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null
        vgchange -ay "$vg" >/dev/null
        install -d -m 0750 "$mountpoint_path"
        if ! mountpoint -q "$mountpoint_path"; then
            mount -o nodev,nosuid,noexec "$lv" "$mountpoint_path"
        fi
        ;;
    stop)
        if mountpoint -q "$mountpoint_path"; then
            umount "$mountpoint_path"
        fi
        vgchange -an "$vg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        loopdev=$(find_loop)
        if [ -n "$loopdev" ]; then
            losetup -d "$loopdev"
        fi
        ;;
    status)
        findmnt "$mountpoint_path"
        lvs "$vg"
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
APPDATA_SCRIPT
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/appdata-volume
cat > /etc/systemd/system/appdata-volume.service <<'APPDATA_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Application data LVM volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target umount.target
Conflicts=umount.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/appdata-volume start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/appdata-volume stop

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
APPDATA_UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/appdata-volume.service
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/appdata-volume /etc/systemd/system/appdata-volume.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable appdata-volume.service
systemctl start appdata-volume.service
systemctl is-enabled appdata-volume.service
systemctl is-active appdata-volume.service
